inputs.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, cover page
inputs.quote: The number of shares outstanding of the registrant's common stock as of September 29, 2026, was 443,129,349 .

source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 5
source.quote: On September 29, 2026, we had 10,703 stockholders of record.

notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK). CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026; Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities. The CalPERS percentage divides its September 30, 2026 shares by the FY2026 10-K cover count at September 29, 2026, the same count used in the marketcap lens. Holders of record are from the FY2026 10-K.
